headline: 10-year U.S. Treasury yield hits highest level since November 2023
detail: Higher Treasury yields typically put pressure on growth and tech stocks by increasing the cost of capital and making future earnings less valuable. This could lead to further drawdowns in your heavily concentrated tech/chip portfolio.
rec: Consider trimming positions flagged by your scanner (QQQ, SMH, QQQI) to reduce overall tech exposure and risk in this environment.

headline: We're starting positions in 2 more defensive stocks to balance our AI exposure
detail: This headline suggests a broader market shift where even those with AI exposure are seeking balance with defensive plays. This sentiment could put further pressure on your concentrated tech/chip holdings.
rec: No direct trade from this headline, but it reinforces the need to monitor your tech concentration and risk.
